data.name: Space Interface
data.detailed_description:
Humanity was living with many shortages of resources as they were running thin. This caused many difficult problems with wars and declining living conditions. In the far reaches of space there was located the remains of a star system long extinguished with inumerable resources. An automated factory was dispatched at a velocity no human could survive. After the long trip the factory created and dispersed stations and drones to mine the system.

Build your credits, grow and manage your fleet, set up strategic situations, execute your tactics in combat.

  •  Simple but effective weapon systems

  • Sensors offer information versus risk

  • Navigation uses newtonian physics

  • Drones execute auto behaviors for fundamental processes

  • Grouping mechanism allows for multi-unit operations

  • Designed to demonstrate and reward both tactical and strategic player capabilities

  • Drones build enlisted ranks in the XP system

  • Players get a portion of the XP towards officer ranks when drones earn XP

  • Kills get tallied in a server-wide leaderboard

  • This game consists of a highly configurable user interface comprised of real time symbology in a Tactical view along with live tables of information and drone controls
